rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a short description of a book, film, or other work.

example.english: The blurb on the back cover of this book is quite appealing.
example.traditional: 呢本書封面背脊嗰段簡介寫得幾吸引。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 fung1 min2 bui3 zek3 go2 dyun6 gaan2 gaai3 se2 dak1 gei2 kap1 jan5

rows.note: Use this when stressing that the short description is marketing copy written to promote the work.

example.english: The publisher asked someone to rewrite the book's blurb to make people want to buy it immediately.
example.traditional: 出版社請人重新寫過本書嘅宣傳文案，務求令人即刻想買。
example.jyutping: ceot1 baan2 se5 ceng2 jan4 cung4 san1 se2 gwo3 bun2 syu1 ge3 syun1 cyun4 man4 on3 mou6 kau4 ling6 jan4 zik1 hak1 soeng2 maai5
